sentCopy.help: Uses the effective SMTP username and password. Save settings before testing. Leave this off if your provider already saves SMTP mail to Sent, to avoid duplicates. Blank folder discovers the unique selectable \Sent mailbox, then existing Sent. Copy failures do not resend mail and are not retried. SSL/TLS usually uses port 993; STARTTLS usually uses 143. Changing security keeps your entered port.
sentCopy.SAVED: Email sent and saved to Sent.
sentCopy.FAILED: Email sent, but saving to Sent failed. Do not resend; check IMAP settings.
